data_description.start_threshold: Power above this level signals the appliance has started.
data_description.start_delay: Seconds power must stay above the start threshold before the cycle begins. Filters brief power spikes. Set to 0 to react immediately.
data_description.idle_threshold: Power below this level signals the appliance is idle or paused.
data_description.pause_delay: Seconds power must stay below the idle threshold before the appliance is considered paused. Filters mid-cycle power dips. Set to 0 to react immediately.
data_description.idle_timeout: Minutes of sustained low power (after the pause delay) before a cycle is marked as finished.

confirm_non_power.title: Sensor is not a power sensor
confirm_non_power.description:
The selected sensor `{entity_id}` reports device class `{device_class}`. This integration expects a power sensor (watts). Energy sensors (kWh, monotonically increasing) will not work — the state machine relies on the value dropping when the appliance pauses or finishes.

Submit to continue anyway, or cancel and select a different sensor.

error.sensor_not_found: The selected sensor entity was not found.
error.sensor_not_numeric: The selected sensor does not report a numeric value.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already configured.
